title: Dishwashing at Bishop's Cafe in Tulsa
summary: Summer job washing dishes in a big Tulsa cafe while his mother stays with his brother in Sand Springs.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So we were just good buddies along and everything. When that was over, I went on then to finish school, a junior, and so that summer, before going to school, I came to Tulsa, my brother was teaching in Sand Springs, and I decided then that I was going to come up there and my mother said yes, she'll go up and stay
with my brother, so I got me a job dishwashing in Bishop's Cafe. At that time, that was one of the big cafe's in Tulsa.
